[Discussion Forum](https://uidai.gov.in/hi/discussion-forum)  # Discussion Forum Welcome to UIDAI Aadhaar Authentication discussion group. This group is created to facilitate Aadhaar Authentication related technical and integration discussions. By joining this group you automatically agree to the terms and conditions (user agreement) of this group mentioned below. All developer related content can be obtained at Aadhaar Developer Portal.
